title: Answer (v1)
description: A person's answer to one item. The page writes it to answers/<item id>; agents only read it. One document per item: a newer answer replaces the older one, and withdrawing an answer deletes the document.

item_id.description: The item this answers. Equal to the document id.

item_rev.description: The item's rev at the moment the person answered. If the item's rev is now higher, the question changed after this answer and the answer no longer applies.

kind.description: choose = picked one option (see key). reply = answered in words instead (see note). reassign = not the right person (see reassign_to).

key.description: kind choose: the picked option's key.

note.description: Free text. Required for kind reply; optional otherwise.

reassign_to.description: kind reassign: the owner key who should decide instead, or null when the person does not know who.

answered_by.description: Opaque claude.ai user id of the person who answered, or null outside claude.ai. Resolve it to a name with the ArtifactData profiles action; never store names.

via.description: card = answered on the item itself. batch = accepted together with other recommendations in one confirmation.
